ابتغيا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَغَيَا (ibtaḡayā) /ib.ta.ɣa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# اُبْتُغِيَا (ubtuḡiyā) /ub.tu.ɣi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# اِبْتَغِيَا (ibtaḡiyā) /ib.ta.ɣi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
